verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs show that manual journal entries can be posted one by one or in bulk through a CSV import template. Editing a posted entry automatically creates a reversing entry and posts a corrected one. The evidence never mentions debit/credit balance validation or memo fields, so those parts of the story are unproven. Missing for 10: documented enforcement of balanced debits and credits, documented memo/supporting-note fields on entries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can post manual journal entries with balanced debits, credits, and supporting memos

citations.quote: Need to post more than one manual journal entry at a time? Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
Puzzle automatically creates a voiding (reversing) journal entry for the original and posts a new entry reflecting your changes.
